Roofing Contractor Near Me – Build Heritage

You can get a free, written and itemized roof replacement quote within one business day. Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and the wider Georgia area with licensed and insured roofing professionals.

How the roof replacement process works

  1. Submit the quote form or email info@buildheritage.org.
  2. Receive a detailed estimate in one business day.
  3. Our crew removes the old roof, installs new roofing and tiles, and cleans the site.
  4. Review the itemized quote, approve the work, and we schedule the start date.

What you can expect

  • Full roof replacement covering the roofing and tile trade.
  • Cost guide (updated August 2026) shows typical residential roof replacement between $9,000‑$20,000.
  • Hold back 10‑15% of the quoted amount to cover any hidden issues that may appear during the project.

Service areas

We work in Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah and Columbus.

Additional trades we offer

Beyond roofing, Build Heritage provides packing & moving, painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, and window‑door trim.

FAQ

How quickly will I receive a quote? You will get a written, itemized estimate within one business day of contacting us.

Are you licensed and insured in Georgia? Yes. Build Heritage is licensed and insured in Georgia.

Do you serve my location? We cover the full list of cities above. If you are unsure, check our service areas page.

Can I get a cost guide for my project? The cost guide is available on our website and includes the $9,000‑$20,000 range for roof replacement.

Next step

Ready to start? Fill out the quote form or email info@buildheritage.org to request your free roof replacement quote today.
